# Project II (M-CCIA) - Milestone Tracking

## 📋 Overview

This repository tracks the progress of **Project II** from the Master's in Creative Computing and Artificial Intelligence (M-CCIA) program at University of Europe Coimbra.

**Semester:** II, 2025-2026 
**Professor:** José Graça
**Team Size:** 2 students per group

---

## 📅 Project Timeline & Milestones

### Phase 1: Research and Concept Development (Weeks 1-3)

**Timeline:** February 2 - February 9, 2026

| Task | Date | Deliverables |
|------|------|---------------|
| Presentation of Briefing | Feb 2 | Briefing acknowledgment |
| Formation of groups | Feb 2-3 | Team assignments |
| Research & Technology Assignment | Feb 3-9 | Technology selection per group |
| Group Assessment | Feb 9/16* | Moodboard; Explanatory Document |

> *Feb 16 marked as holiday in original brief - may be extended

**Focus Areas:**
- Emergent Technologies (VR/AR ecosystems, sensor hardware)
- Generative AI applications
- Interface Design principles
- Concept development and asset production

### Phase 2: Prototyping and Technical Exploration (Weeks 3-7)

**Timeline:** February 9 - March 16, 2026

| Task | Date Range | Deliverables |
|------|------------|---------------|
| Support for user flow design | Feb 9-14 | Interactive prototypes |
| Group Assessment Round 1 | Feb 16* | Moodboard; Explanatory Document |
| Technical Implementation | Feb 23 - Mar 7 | Functional prototype |
| Iterative Development | Mar 7-14 | Refined functionality |
| Final Prototype Submission | Mar 16 | Working prototype |

**Focus Areas:**
- Sensor-based interactions (body tracking, gesture recognition)
- AI-driven functionalities (pose estimation, generative AI)
- Visual/audio asset production
- Integration into digital fashion experience

## 📁 Required Deliverables

### Production Dossier/Report (All Milestones)

- Weekly activity plan contextualized by each unit
- Research about related projects
- Emerging Technologies section: hardware/frameworks integration strategy
- Applied Machine Learning section: models, datasets, performance metrics
- Interface Design section: UX/UI documentation
- Project management layer documentation

### Technical Deliverables

- Source code repository with comprehensive README
- Functional prototype demonstrations
- Visual assets (images, video, audio)
- Accessibility compliance reports
- Performance benchmarking data

## 🎓 Project Theme Options

Select one theme for your exploration:

- **Identity:** Evolution of self-expression with technology
- **Body:** Technology as body extension and perception shift
- **Society:** Building community in digital fashion contexts
- **Culture:** Cultural concepts communicated through new tech
- **Wearables:** Functional/communicative body technologies
- **Industry 5.0:** Human-machine creative collaboration
- **Consumption:** Tech-altered shopping experiences
